identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a high-velocity, high-contrast command center for solar sales.
core_principles: Speed is Feature #1: Visuals must enable sub-second decision making.
Gold Standard: Use Gold/Yellow not just as decoration, but as the primary 'Action' signal.
Darkness is Canvas: The UI is dark to reduce eye strain and make data pop.
Density with Breath: High data density, but distinct separation via borders and negative space.

heading.usage: Page titles, Metric values, Modal headers

body.usage: General text, form labels, table content

mono.usage: IDs, Phone numbers, Currency, SLA timers

rules: Overlines: Uppercase, Tracking wide (0.05em), Text-xs, Font-bold.
Numbers: Use tabular-nums for all data grids and timers.

buttons.primary: bg-brand-yellow text-black hover:bg-brand-yellow/90 font-bold shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(245,158,11,0.3)] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10 hover:border-white/40

inputs.style: bg-brand-dark border-white/10 text-white focus:border-brand-yellow/50 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-yellow/50 placeholder:text-white/20 h-10

kanban_column.style: min-w-[320px] max-w-[320px] bg-brand-gray/50 rounded-xl border border-white/5 flex flex-col h-full
kanban_column.header: p-3 border-b border-white/5 font-bold text-sm tracking-wide uppercase text-white/80 sticky top-0 bg-brand-gray/95 backdrop-blur z-10

kanban_card.style: bg-brand-dark border border-white/10 rounded-md p-3 mb-3 hover:border-brand-yellow/30 cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing shadow-sm group relative

visual_enhancers.gradients: No full background gradients. Use localized 'glow' spots behind key metrics or active states.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-md for the Sidebar and Sticky Headers. Opacity 90%.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px borders are mandatory for all cards to define hierarchy in dark mode. Opacity 5-10%.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal use. Rely on contrast and borders.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure White text on Dark Gray background meets AA standards.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible ring-2 ring-brand-yellow/50 on all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.

assets.icons: Use Lucide React for UI. Use Phosphor Icons (Bold weight) for specific dashboard widgets if needed.

images.placeholder_strategy: Use abstract geometric patterns or high-contrast solar panel details for empty states. No generic illustrations.

universal_guidelines: Interactive elements MUST have a hover state that changes brightness or border color.
Forms must use labels. Placeholders are not replacements for labels.
Data density is key for this CRM: Avoid excessive padding inside data tables. Use compact rows.
Dark Mode is the ONLY mode. Hardcode colors if necessary, or configure Tailwind to default to dark.
instructions_to_main_agent: 2. CONFIG: Update tailwind.config.js to include the specific solar palette (Brand Gold/Yellow).
3. FONT SETUP: Import fonts in index.js/App.js.
4. LAYOUT: Build the SidebarLayout component first. It wraps every page.
5. DASHBOARD: Implement the Bento Grid for the main dashboard metrics.
6. KANBAN: Ensure the Kanban board handles horizontal scrolling and drag-and-drop (use @hello-pangea/dnd or similar).
7. CRITICAL: The 'Next Action' field is the heart of this system. Highlight it in Red if the date is past or missing.
